_comment: First-party Farmer's Delight WILD-CROP compat on the DESERT family (FARMERSDELIGHTPLAN #16). Desert is hot/dry, so it grows wild TOMATOES + BEETROOTS (FD generates both on desert sand — the block supports sand). Appends a top-level 'wild desert crops' variant (used on plain-desert islands) AND merges the same crops into the #minecraft:is_badlands band (selector byte-identical to the base band, so it appends a variant rather than shadowing). Inert without FD: unknown farmersdelight: ids skipped via Lookup.hasBlock → byte-identical generation. IDS VERIFIED vs FarmersDelight-1.21.1-1.3.2.jar (2026-07-03). Shared verbatim across desert/desert_large/huge_desert (mirror-island-tiers rule); only target differs.
